print.heading: print
print.description: Writes the text of a value to standard output, followed by a newline. A string prints without quotes.

range.heading: range
range.description: The integers from `start` up to, but not including, `end`; used as the iterable of a for loop.
range.example: for i in range(0, 3) then print i. end

throw.heading: throw
throw.description: Raises an exception. Its type is Nothing, so it fits any position. A catch binds it as (kind: Atom, message: String).
throw.example: x > 0 then x else throw(kind: not_found, message: "no such row").

type.heading: type
type.description: The name of a value's type as a string: Integer, Long, Float, Double, Character, String, Boolean, Atom, List, Map, Pair, Nil, or the class of an object.

is_atom.heading: is_atom
is_atom.description: True only for a data atom: never for a string, number, class reference or function reference.

length.heading: length
length.description: The number of items of a list or a Java array. Positional, like every builtin.

len.heading: len
len.description: The number of items of a list or a Java array (the member form: `items.len()`).

console:write.heading: console.write
console:write.description: Writes the text of a value to standard output, with no trailing newline.

console:writeLine.heading: console.writeLine
console:writeLine.description: Writes the text of a value to standard output, followed by a newline (what `print` also does).

Character.heading: Character
Character.description: Converts a one-letter string to a char.

Graph:Link.heading: Graph.Link
Graph:Link.description: Stores an edge between two stored facts (needs `import org.felidae.graph`), named by their keys. `type` is forward (the default), backward or both; `properties` is a map literal of scalar values. Both facts must be stored.
Graph:Link.example: Graph.Link(from: ada.id, to: research.id, type: forward, properties: {kind: "works_in"}).

Graph:Unlink.heading: Graph.Unlink
Graph:Unlink.description: Removes a stored link (needs `import org.felidae.graph`). It takes the arguments of Graph.Link, and the link must be stored.

key.heading: key
key.description: Names a class's key field(s) (else the first field is the key). Structural, not an expression: written unprefixed in the class body.

db:location.heading: db.location
db:location.description: Called in a `static init` block: where the TidesDB store lives, relative to the project root (default `felidae-data` there). A program that writes facts opens the database at the first one.

db:config.heading: db.config
db:config.description: Sets a TidesDB option, currently only the log level.

db:stats.heading: db.stats
db:stats.description: Where the database is and whether it is open, as a map (`path`, `open`).

db:stop.heading: db.stop
db:stop.description: Closes the database; the next fact written opens it again.

count.heading: count
count.description: The number of facts of the class, or of the selection.

all.heading: all
all.description: Every fact of the class, or of the selection, in key order, as a typed List.

first.heading: first
first.description: The first fact in key order, or nil (an Optional of the class).

get.heading: get
get.description: The fact at a position in key order (a member of the class, a selection, or a List).

exists.heading: exists
exists.description: True when a fact matches the equality filters.

find.heading: find
find.description: The fact that matches the equality filters, or nil.

where.heading: where
where.description: Starts a selection of the facts whose fields equal the given values. Nothing is read until a member such as count or all runs it.

AndWhere.heading: AndWhere
AndWhere.description: Narrows a selection: the facts must also match these equality filters.

OrWhere.heading: OrWhere
OrWhere.description: Widens a selection with another set of equality filters.

limit.heading: limit
limit.description: Keeps the first n facts of a selection, in key order.

insert.heading: insert
insert.description: Stores a new fact from a map of field values. It is an error if the key already exists.

update.heading: update
update.description: Sets fields on every fact of a selection. A key field can never be updated.

delete.heading: delete
delete.description: Deletes every fact of a selection. A fact that a link names cannot be deleted until it is unlinked.

save.heading: save
save.description: Writes an instance again (a class's own constructor calls it to store the fact).

join.heading: join
join.description: Walks the links from the selected facts to facts of another class (needs import org.felidae.graph) and returns typed rows (left, right, properties, depth).

recursive_join.heading: recursive_join
recursive_join.description: Follows links breadth first (needs import org.felidae.graph) up to max_depth and gives each reachable fact of the class once, at its least depth. max_depth is required.

shortest_path.heading: shortest_path
shortest_path.description: For each selected fact (needs import org.felidae.graph), the row for a target fact at the fewest links. max_depth is required.

sum.heading: sum
sum.description: Sums a numeric field named in a string; the type is the field's (0 for no facts).

average.heading: average
average.description: The average of a numeric field, an Optional of Double (nil for no facts).

min.heading: min
min.description: The smallest value of a numeric field, an Optional of the field's type.

max.heading: max
max.description: The largest value of a numeric field, an Optional of the field's type.

order_by.heading: order_by
order_by.description: Sorts a list of maps ascending by a numeric field, stably. The maps must all have the same fields.
